g.text: B. Illustrative dielectric load: 100 kW real power, C = 10 nF, loss tangent = 0.1
Voltage connects the power supply to the reactor
Panel B is a calculation, not a vendor rating: V = sqrt[P / (2π f C tanδ)]. Properties assumed constant.
Generator terminals and reactor electrodes are different boundaries; matching changes voltage/current.
Sources: voltage_sources.csv and sources.md. Model assumptions and limits: reactor_matching.md.
